title: Teneggi 2013 Experiment 3 cooperation PPS scaffold
citation: Teneggi, C., Canzoneri, E., di Pellegrino, G., & Serino, A. (2013). Social modulation of peripersonal space boundaries. Current Biology, 23(5), 406-411.
notes: Experiment 3 only: approaching four-second sound with 500 ms silence before and after, and seven reported sound-relative SOAs. The one-per-SOA preview is a software scaffold: Experiment 3 repetitions, integer catches and block allocation are not separately reported in the reviewed supplement. No tactile-only baseline class is reported for this experiment. The premade Gaussian burst train and binaural path are substitutions for the original intensity-modulated pink sound; the shared 100-ms audio cue substitutes for the 100-microsecond electrical stimulus. Pre/post cooperation, physical stimulation and voice-key capture need separate implementation. This is not a replication-ready preset.

reference_parameters.source_pointer: Supplemental Experimental Procedures, PDF pp. 7-9 of 11; Experiment 3 paragraph
reference_parameters.software_trial_count_basis: Preview choice only: one presentation per SOA, no catches, one block. Experiment 3 repetition, integer catch and block counts are not separately reported; the eight repetitions and 80+24 trials described for Experiments 1/2 must not be inherited.
implementation_gaps: Experiment 3 exact repetition, integer catch and block counts are unreported; preview counts are software defaults
exact original pink-noise intensity envelope and speaker transfer; premade Gaussian burst train is a source substitution
100-microsecond electrical pulse and voice-key response capture require external apparatus
pre/post cooperative economic-game context with the same fair confederate is not implemented

provenance.source: Teneggi 2013 Supplemental Experimental Procedures, PDF pp. 7-9 of 11, https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S096098221300078X-mmc1.pdf. Experiment 3: N=20, IN only, 4 s sound, 500 ms pre/post silence, seven SOAs 250/750/1300/1800/2500/3200/3700 ms; 100-microsecond electrical pulses. The preceding 8 x 5 x 2 = 80 target +24 catch count applies to Experiments 1/2, not Experiment 3.

One-per-SOA preview counts, binaural premade Gaussian burst-train asset, and 100-ms audio-channel tactile cue are explicit toolkit substitutions. Social intervention and original apparatus are not recreated.
